onboard.claude.title: Connect your Claude account
onboard.claude.hint: Authorize Claude to finish setting things up.
onboard.claude.open: Open this link and authorize access with your Claude account:
onboard.claude.pasteCode: Copy the authorization code and paste it here:
onboard.claude.connectError: Could not connect your Claude account.
onboard.account.title: Claude · your usage (optional)
onboard.account.hint: Connect your account to see your plan’s actual usage.
onboard.account.usageNote: This shows the actual usage percentages for your 5-hour session and your weekly limit.
onboard.account.optionalNote: Without this step, the Usage panel will only show the tokens you’ve consumed. You don’t need it to start working, and you can connect it later from Claude · your usage.
onboard.account.open: The page cannot open automatically because the CLI is running on a server without a graphical interface. Open this link and authorize access with your Claude account:
onboard.account.pasteCode: Copy the code Claude gives you and paste it here:
onboard.codex.title: Connect Codex
onboard.codex.hint: Authorize Codex to use Tandem mode.
onboard.codex.note: Codex is required: it runs code for Tandem mode using your isolated user account.
onboard.codex.authorize: Open the link, paste this code, and authorize access with your ChatGPT account. The code expires in 15 minutes.
onboard.codex.autoAdvance: This screen will continue automatically when you’re done.
onboard.infisical.title: Connect Infisical
onboard.infisical.hint: This gives you access to Tolkien tools.
onboard.infisical.note: Infisical is required: it stores the secrets needed by the Tolkien MCP and its tools.
onboard.infisical.open: Open this link and sign in to Infisical:
onboard.infisical.pasteToken: Copy the token shown by Infisical and paste it here:
onboard.github.title: Connect GitHub
onboard.github.hint: Authorize the CLI to work with your repositories over HTTPS.
onboard.github.note: GitHub is required. Your session and Git configuration stay in your isolated user HOME.
onboard.github.authorize: Paste the code into GitHub and approve access. This screen will continue automatically when you’re done.
onboard.github.interrupted: It looks like the GitHub login was interrupted.
onboard.smoke.invalidResponse: The server returned an incomplete check.
onboard.smoke.title: Checking your access
onboard.smoke.hint: We’re testing each connection before setup is complete.
onboard.smoke.chatCost: The chat check validates your credentials without generating a response, so it does not use tokens.
onboard.smoke.failedHint: Some features will not work yet. You can fix them now or continue anyway.
onboard.smoke.skippedHint: Some setup work has not finished yet. You can try again or continue anyway.
